tables.caption: Launch authority of nuclear states
rows: Briefcases may also be issued to the Minister of Defence and the Chief of the General Staff. [ 78 ] [ 80 ] [ 81 ] [ 79 ]
Prime Minister of the United Kingdom

The prime minister and a secretly designated 'second' may order a launch. However, as formal commander-in-chief the Monarch can overturn the decision if Ministry of Defence officials refer a disputed launch order for review, and Parliament can challenge through a successful vote of no confidence to remove the Prime Minister. [ 78 ] [ 79 ]
The Chief of the Military Staff of the President of the Republic and the Chief of the Defence Staff may also be involved in decisions. [ 78 ] [ 79 ]
Chairman of the Central Military Commission
The chairman of the Central Military Commission is the supreme military commander and is held by the Chinese Communist Party general secretary. [ 78 ] [ 79 ] [ 82 ]
Nuclear Command Authority includes an Executive Council and a Political Council. [ 78 ] [ 79 ]
Approval from National Command Authority and requires a consensus of the council's members. [ 78 ] [ 79 ]

The president of the state affairs is the ultimate decisionmaker in regards to North Korea's nuclear arsenal. The position is held by the WPK general secretary and serves as the supreme leader of North Korea. [ 83 ]
Requires agreement of the Minister of Defense and Chief of the General Staff. [ 78 ]
